blocks.text: About 3 million holders of persons with disabilities (PWDs) IDs will have to enroll in the new unified digital ID system that seeks to phase out the old physical IDs in the next three years and flag bogus ones. Signed in July this year, Administrative Order (AO) No. 001, s. 2026, of the National Council
